scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,app,admin,superadmin -c green,blue,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @flowledger/api" "npm run dev -w @flowledger/app" "npm run dev -w @flowledger/admin" "npm run dev -w @flowledger/superadmin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @flowledger/api && npm run build -w @flowledger/app && npm run build -w @flowledger/admin && npm run build -w @flowledger/superadmin
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @flowledger/api && npm run lint -w @flowledger/app && npm run lint -w @flowledger/admin && npm run lint -w @flowledger/superadmin
